The audit classified it as a replication on the caption alone. Someone must decide whether the intended video (see A021, dead gfycat) is recoverable or whether this row should simply be merged into A020.

The stored artist 'Alice' is the fictional character and must not become a contributor profile; the caption's 'Alice by Lewis Caroll' names the author, not the illustrator. The real credit is Sir John Tenniel, public domain.
